title: More than one non-human species, not all benevolent

tellings.quote: another thing uh that not every spec there were more than one species and there weren't all as benevolent as

plain: In 1964 at Vandenberg Air Force Base in California, a guard at a nuclear missile site named Richard Barth says he learned from beings who took him that there is more than one non-human species, and that not all of them are as benevolent as the ones he met. Barth tells it as part of his own abduction experience. If true, it would mean that whatever is visiting does not all share the same intentions toward people.
